shared_elements: linear incised marks on a large wall surface
small circles/discs (rosettes in A, circles in B)
justification: The only real correspondence is formal and generic: both surfaces carry incised linear marks organised into horizontal registers with repeated vertical units, and both contain small circular forms. Otherwise the depicted content is wholly different \u2014 A shows a naturalistically modelled procession of standing human figures with garments, weapons and rosette bands, while B shows purely abstract schematic signs (crosses, lattices, strokes, arcs) with no figures at all.
